name: Sustainable Connections — local businesses — when
note: Timeline companion to the RCN Map issue whatcom-wa--sustainable-connections-directory. One bar per business (236 of 266) from when it began to today, coloured by the directory's nine sections, oldest at the top. Year-only dates sit at mid-year with half a year of fuzz; 'about' dates carry a year of fuzz and lower confidence; contractor license dates are marked as such and are not necessarily the day the business began. Every bar names its source in 'who'. Each bar's id is the business's first point on the map, and 'coops' lists all its points (the shared bridge field). No start date was found for 30: Ardor Salon; Bellingham Balloon Decor; Boulton Vineyard and Cellars; Cascade Computer Consulting; Crave Catering; Envision Homes; Five Star Bath Solutions Northwest; FotoMataio Fotografia; Giant Killer Shark; Golden Ranch Farm; Happy Chix Farm; Light Source Residential Design; Litav Langley Consulting LLC; Local 180 Market; MK Consulting; Molly Maguire Landscape Architecture; Mystic Heart Meditation Soundscapes; Nine Lives Ranch; Primavera farm; Relics Design LLC; SC Consulting; Sharper By Parker – Knife Sharpening; Sundara West; The Skagit Table; The Union Coffee Shop; Valley Grown Produce; Verduras Organicas Mexicanas; Wandering Chef Will; West Coast Equity Group; White Barn Floral Co. Built by tools/sc-directory/build.py from tools/sc-directory/started.json. Researched Oct 2026 by Marc Pierson with Claude Opus 5.5.
